svg.title: How the code is laid out
svg.desc: The popup and the switcher are pages of the extension that players.js draws, the options page keeps the settings of the button, and the welcome page guides the first set-up. They send their requests to background.js, the service worker, which wires the browser to the logic in src/, built into extension/lib/. There switch.ts makes every change of the accounts, one at a time through queue.ts, with state.ts for the saved accounts, storage.ts to store them with the version of their format, and autodarts.ts for the sign-in service of Autodarts; tabs.ts picks the Autodarts tab, health.ts plans the renewal and the badge, page.ts decides for the switcher, and onboarding.ts for the first set-up and the bug report. The logic reaches chrome.storage.local, api.autodarts.com and content.js only through what background.js passes in. content.js runs in each Autodarts tab, shows the button and the frame of the switcher, and is the only code that reads or writes the session of the page.
